name: Sentry API
tagline: Programmatic access to Sentry error monitoring, issues, projects, and releases.
description: REST API for Sentry's error monitoring platform. Manage organizations, projects, issues, events, releases, and alert rules. Authenticate with auth tokens. Supports SaaS (sentry.io) and self-hosted instances. Used to automate issue triage, release tracking, and monitoring integrations.

auth.details: Bearer token via Authorization header (auth tokens from User Settings > Auth Tokens, or organization tokens). Scopes control access. Also supports session cookies for browser sessions.

use_cases: list unresolved issues for a project
create a release and attach commits
fetch error event details by ID
update issue status or assign ownership
